rationale: The short thesis is mechanically intact — price remains pinned below session VWAP ($8.81) and the 9-EMA ($8.66), sits at the low of day on a risk-off tape (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.66%), and every bounce since entry has died under the $8.47 shelf on shrinking volume, which reads as consolidation under the breakdown level rather than absorption. Volume dried from 43.9k to 5–13k in a tight $8.40–$8.47 coil, and no headline has emerged to force a reassessment, so neither the $8.68 invalidation nor the 3% trail has any reason to trigger. I considered closing to bank the ~$28 available after the wide 36 bps spread, and rejected flipping long because counter-trend knife-catching against a falling VWAP and tape is far weaker evidence than simply letting a working, in-profit breakdown position run.
